title: I Followed the Vaccine-Clinic Sticker After They Called My Slot a Walk-In

parts.text: I held the sticker at 9:19 a.m. with my slot still on the board they called a walk-in. Desk lead Peri said stickers were atmosphere. I was thirty-seven, patient, standing in a line that made me look like I owned the wait. The sticker said 9:10 BOOKED. The board said WALK-IN. I photographed the sticker, the board, and Peri's override. Then I asked for the clinic log. Peri laughed until nursing asked for the photo. The slot returned. Peri sticker-dates the board now. A sticker is only a sticker until someone treats it like a clock.

social.video_title: They called my booked vaccine slot a walk-in — Part 1/1
social.description: 9:10 sticker, walk-in board, an override. Nursing asked for the photo. Has a desk ever unbooked you in person?
